# Icy Power (אייסי פאוור)

> Icy Power runs guided ice-bath and breathwork (Wim Hof Method) workshops in Israel for corporate team-building days, company wellness events, private groups, bachelor/bachelorette parties, birthdays and couples. Founded by brothers Oron and Eldar. Based in Savyon (central Israel) and travels to clients all over the country - Tel Aviv and the Gush Dan area, the Sharon, Jerusalem, Haifa and the north, Be'er Sheva and the south. All equipment (ice tubs, ice) is brought to the client's location; no experience needed. Pricing is quoted per group (type of session, group size, location). Contact: WhatsApp / phone +972-54-878-7766, icypowerteam@gmail.com, Instagram @the.icy.power.il. Site language: Hebrew.

## Services
- [Team building for companies (גיבוש לחברות וצוותים)](https://icypower.pages.dev/business): ice-bath and breathwork workshop for teams, HR days and company fun days; reduces stress, connects the team, gives practical tools. At the office or any venue in Israel.
- [Private groups (קבוצות פרטיות)](https://icypower.pages.dev/private-groups): a shared challenge for groups of friends and families, anywhere in Israel.
- [Parties and events (אירועים ומסיבות)](https://icypower.pages.dev/events): bachelor and bachelorette parties, birthdays, special events.
- [Evening retreat (ריטריט ערב)](https://icypower.pages.dev/evening-retreat): an evening wellness retreat for groups at a villa in Savyon - breathwork, ice bath, sound healing.
- [Open workshop (סדנה פתוחה)](https://icypower.pages.dev/open-session): individuals join a scheduled group session.
- [Couples workshop (סדנת זוגות)](https://icypower.pages.dev/couples)
- [Book a morning workshop (הזמנת מקום)](https://icypower.pages.dev/booking)

## Key facts
- Group size: from a couple up to dozens or hundreds of participants.
- Water temperature 3-8°C; immersion 1-5 minutes, fully guided.
- Not suitable during pregnancy, or with heart conditions or epilepsy; every participant signs a short health declaration.
- Bring: swimsuit, towel, flip-flops, warm clothes for after.
